title: header search placeholder visible search control
rule: Header search may use placeholder + visible Search control — the only named placeholder-as-visible-label exception: visually hidden `<label>`, placeholder “Zoek”, submit with text and/or magnifying-glass. Does not pass on ordinary fields. Dual-cite Forms no-placeholder-as-label. Placeholder/label lock unchanged.
pass_when: Header search: hidden `<label>` + placeholder “Zoek” + visible Search control. Ordinary fields still have a visible label (lock).
fail_when: An ordinary field uses placeholder as its only label, citing this exception; or header search has no visible Search control and no accessible name.
overview: Header search may pair a hidden label and Zoek placeholder with a visible Search control.
apply_when: Building the site header search field with a visible Search affordance.
not_when: Not for ordinary fields; placeholder-as-only-label remains banned elsewhere.
agent_hint: For header search only: hidden label, Zoek placeholder, and a visible Search control.
description: Header search is the named exception: a visually hidden `<label>`, placeholder “Zoek”, and a submit with text and/or magnifying-glass. Ordinary fields still need a visible label; this exception does not pass elsewhere. Fail if an ordinary field uses placeholder as its only label citing this exception, or if header search lacks a visible Search control and accessible name. Apply only to site header search with a visible Search affordance.
do_not_claim: Placeholder-as-label as passing on non-search fields; GOLD search attributes as this exception.
